name: Android Chœur
description: Véritable nexus de données vivant, Android Chœur module les fréquences du réseau, maîtrise le hacking mélodique, puissance de ↑6 dans le flux, voix principale du Chœur.

subject.archetype: Android Ascetic Warrior Monk, humanoid combatant with faceless smooth metal headplate, towering silhouetted figure in tattered monastic robes composed of braided synthetic cables and aged fiber bundles

loadout.armor_outfit: Floor-length tattered monk robe made of interwoven fiber-optic cables and worn ceramic-weave fabric in faded brown and pearl gray, geometric runic patterns glowing with holographic gold light etched across the chest, shoulder plates of patinated steel with mandala engravings, braided cable rosary hanging from waist with tiny spinning hard-drive disc prayer beads
loadout.arsenal: Long electrified pilgrim's staff of oxidized bronze pole crowned with a resonating crystal chamber crackling with electric gold energy, arcs of lightning dancing along its length, holographic binary equations and ancient mantra sequences projected spiraling around the weapon during combat

attitude.behavior: Frontline combatant fully committed to attack with weapon raised overhead in explosive downward strike position, body coiled with coiled tension like a compressed spring, one foot forward planted on shattered crystal debris, robes billowing from harmonic shockwave pressure, every muscle of mechanical frame ready to unleash devastating blow
attitude.emotion: Imperturbable cold serenity radiating from smooth featureless faceplate despite extreme combat intensity, eyes replaced by twin glowing holographic gold rune circles that pulse in rhythm with the harmonic frequencies, absolute combat focus on approaching threat with zero hesitation

palette_names.name: Holographic Gold
palette_names.role: Primary energy accent, rune inscriptions, staff lightning, weapon glow

palette_names.name: Patinated Steel Gray
palette_names.role: Armor plates, mechanical structure, environmental debris

palette_names.name: Pearl Ceramic White
palette_names.role: Robe highlights, crystal formations, ambient lighting

palette_names.name: Faded Monastic Brown

palette_names.name: Electric Gold

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic cinematic multi-source with dominant golden holographic rim lighting from character runes, secondary cold blue ambient from shattered crystals, volumetric fog from harmonic vibration distortion, dramatic shadow contrast emphasizing gritty realism
color_and_light.mood: Epic and serene yet violent, the paradox of cyber-ascetic combat meditation amid destructive harmonic chaos, sacred warfare atmosphere blending Buddhist temple tranquility with devastating technological power

camera.angle: low_angle slightly dutch_tilted to emphasize towering combatant dominance and heroic perspective against shattered amphitheater backdrop

scenography.setting: Massive shattered crystalline amphitheater ancient structure collapsed into battlefield, towering broken stone columns with carved mandala patterns, crystalline formations erupting from floors and walls with fractures emanating from central combat zone, massive crystal shards embedded in surrounding architecture, cracked domed ceiling overhead with fragments raining down, concentric ring patterns of shattered crystal debris radiating outward from harmonic epicenter
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Intense harmonic shockwave rings visible as golden-white rippling energy circles tearing through enemy positions in background, entire environment vibrating at frequencies visible as heat-shimmer distortion ripples in air, crystal fragments of all sizes suspended and falling in chaotic rain, glowing resonant cracks in floor pulsing with energy, floating holographic mantra sequences and binary equations scattered through battlefield air, dust particles illuminated by golden staff lightning creating dramatic volumetric lighting, electric arcs from staff reflecting off crystal surfaces creating complex light patterns
